description: Land Title Settlement Department - Land parcel in Siyambalanduwa D/S Division, Monaragala District & other Land Parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act, dealing specifically with land ownership, possession, and interest claims for various land parcels across multiple districts. The content focuses exclusively on land registration and title settlement matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
